name: obsidian-vault
description: One shared Obsidian vault with a folder per repository: conventions skill, a read-only vault-reader and a vault-writer agent, and an opt-in hook that asks for a vault update after git push.

interface.shortDescription: Keep one Obsidian vault with durable context per repository folder.
interface.longDescription: Conventions for creating, reading, and updating a per-repository folder in a shared Obsidian vault through the Obsidian MCP, with an admission rule that keeps only decisions, gotchas, run outcomes, and glossary terms.
defaultPrompt: What does the vault say about this area of the repo?
Update the vault with what we decided in this session.
